title: Jev decision model (routing note + command gate)
description: Advisory routing note on each prompt and a confirm-before-risky-git/rm gate, via the Jev classifier on OpenRouter; for Claude Code, Codex CLI and opencode.
postInstall: Jev: store your OpenRouter key without echoing it, either as env OPENROUTER_API_KEY or in a key file: mkdir -p ~/.config/jev && printf %s "$KEY" > ~/.config/jev/key && chmod 600 ~/.config/jev/key (respects $XDG_CONFIG_HOME; on Windows a user env var also works). Without a key the hooks stay silent. Opt out: env JEV_HOOK=0 everywhere, or a file .agents/jev-off (or .claude/jev-off) in a project. Cost: about $0.0001 per call (one per routed prompt and per gated git/destructive command). Privacy: the prompt, the tail of the previous reply and, for the gate, the command plus git diff/log output are sent to OpenRouter after secret redaction; the local log keeps only hashes. Claude Code: the gate asks natively. Codex: open /hooks in Codex and trust the two new Jev hooks (new hooks are skipped until reviewed), and restart Codex to load rules/jev-guard.rules; a blocked command must be confirmed by you in chat, then rerun with '# jev-confirmed' appended. opencode: restart it to load plugins/jev.js; same confirm-and-rerun flow.
